enableStudyLog.title: Enable Study Logger?
enableStudyLog.description: If participating in the Nod study, check this box to generate usage logs. Logs are stored in a /nod_study/ folder in your Jupyter config directory. To find this directory, run 'jupyter --paths' in a terminal and look under 'config'

enablePullChanges.title: Enable Pull Source File Changes Button?
enablePullChanges.description: If checked, a button to dangerously update your notebook-on-demand with changes to the source file. This does NOT re-run your program, it only updates the text!
